description: Independently verify an existing Standing Mark: Ed25519 signature over WHP-JCS-I1, recognized-issuer check, mark_id-to-record consistency, record completeness, governing Decision Integrity version, and the claims the record cannot establish. Verification is free and never triggers an evaluation or payment. Verification does not prove the underlying proposition true and does not authorize any action.

response.note: Actual result depends on the service version and configured issuer key; no fabricated verification success is supplied.

envelope.description: A WHP-STANDING-MARK-v1 envelope the caller holds

mark_id.description: Verify a record the service issued and still holds

public_key_base64.description: Optional caller-pinned issuer public key (SPKI base64)

received_material.description: Optional material to bind against object_binding.submitted_bytes_sha256

root_public_key_base64.description: Public root SPKI; possession does not admit its identity.

trust_bundle.description: Optional signed public issuer key history; needs independently configured root policy.

verification_contract.description: 3 opts into record schema 1.8.0; 2 selects strict schema and public-key-pinned inspection; requires envelope and public_key_base64. Default 1 preserves the compatibility verifier.

name: verify_standing_mark
